d: Singapore has blocked access to 14 social media posts targeting the Indian community, invoking its Online Criminal Harms Act in one of the strongest government responses yet to alleged foreign-linked racial disinformation. Authorities say the content portrayed Indians as a threat, questioned the loyalty of Indian politicians, and sought to undermine Singapore's multicultural model. Investigators believe the material originated on a China-based platform before spreading across multiple online networks.
